0400__L13_Sul_31__8E351E44.mp3.asr_text: Hurry up with that damn bunker!
0400__L13_Sul_31__8E351E44.mp3.translation: 快把那个该死的碉堡端了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 快把那个该死的碉堡端了！

0401__L13_Sul_66__939A1DA6.mp3.asr_text: Move in! Let's finish this now!

0402__L13_Sul_24__8CAA8C28.mp3.note: Carson按ASR保留为卡森，未擅自套用卡特等其它角色名字。

0404__L13_Sul_28__8CE2EA2C.mp3.asr_text: Get back there and take that bunker, dammit!
0404__L13_Sul_28__8CE2EA2C.mp3.translation: 回去把那座碉堡拿下，快！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 回去把那座碉堡拿下，快！

0405__L13_Sul_32__8E4335C5.mp3.asr_text: Get down the tunnel and secure that bunker!

0406__L13_Pol_29__367A144A.mp3.asr_text: Bunker secure, Sergeant! Good job, Miller.
0406__L13_Pol_29__367A144A.mp3.translation: 中士，碉堡拿下了！干得好，米勒。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，碉堡拿下了！干得好，米勒。

0408__L13_Pol_57__3B7C6F25.mp3.asr_text: Looks like the enemy's dug deep into some bunkers! Two of them!
0408__L13_Pol_57__3B7C6F25.mp3.translation: 敌人缩进碉堡里了！有两座！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 敌人缩进碉堡里了！有两座！

0410__L13_Sul_42__8FF80E64.mp3.asr_text: Get down! Use the Sherman for cover!
0410__L13_Sul_42__8FF80E64.mp3.translation: 趴下！借谢尔曼坦克作掩护！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 趴下！借谢尔曼坦克作掩护！

0411__L13_Sul_3__4EE8A2C9.mp3.asr_text: We're gonna take that ridge, clearing every trench and every bunker as we go.
0411__L13_Sul_3__4EE8A2C9.mp3.translation: 拿下那道山脊，一路把每条战壕、每座碉堡都清干净。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 拿下那道山脊，一路把每条战壕、每座碉堡都清干净。

0412__L13_Pol_36__3804A666.mp3.asr_text: I can't see him. Anyone got him?

0413__L13_Sul_70__94FA693F.mp3.asr_text: How'd you like this, Polonsky? A genuine Japanese fortress.
0413__L13_Sul_70__94FA693F.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，这个怎么样？货真价实的日式堡垒。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 波隆斯基，这个怎么样？货真价实的日式堡垒。

0414__L13_Red_64__1BE4267D.mp3.translation: 中士，前面有啄木鸟机枪！
0414__L13_Red_64__1BE4267D.mp3.note: Woodpecker为日军机枪绰号，译为啄木鸟机枪。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，前面有啄木鸟机枪！

0415__L13_Pol_62__3CEAD23F.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，进去！把他们逼出来！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，进去！把他们逼出来！

0417__L13_Pol_41__39730980.mp3.asr_text: Enemy ahead, Sergeant! They're crawling out of the damn woodwork!
0417__L13_Pol_41__39730980.mp3.translation: 中士，前面有敌人！怎么哪儿都能冒出来！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，前面有敌人！怎么哪儿都能冒出来！

0418__L13_Sul_45__902254E7.mp3.asr_text: You want to get your head blown off? Stay behind the tank!
0418__L13_Sul_45__902254E7.mp3.translation: 脑袋不想要了？躲到坦克后面！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 脑袋不想要了？躲到坦克后面！

0420__L13_Sul_61__9353A821.mp3.asr_text: Listen up! We move on the right-hand bunker first. Take the perimeter and then we go in for the kill. Everyone ready?
0420__L13_Sul_61__9353A821.mp3.translation: 听好了，先打右边的碉堡。拿下外围，再攻进去。都准备好了吗？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 听好了，先打右边的碉堡。拿下外围，再攻进去。都准备好了吗？

0421__L13_Pol_7__230CA690.mp3.asr_text: Maybe we scare them off and they all belly stick themselves like they do.
0421__L13_Pol_7__230CA690.mp3.translation: 可能被咱们吓跑了，全按他们那套剖腹了。
0421__L13_Pol_7__230CA690.mp3.note: 保留ASR角色说话的原意与调侃语气，属于虚构战时人物台词。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 可能被咱们吓跑了，全按他们那套剖腹了。

0422__L13_Pol_0__22AA0209.mp3.asr_text: So, this is the Shuri line. What a dump.
0422__L13_Pol_0__22AA0209.mp3.translation: 这就是首里防线？真是个破地方。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 这就是首里防线？真是个破地方。

0423__L13_CPT_67__A8C45F2A.mp3.asr_text: It's fine work, men. Japanese defense line is split in two. They're going to have to pull back or be overrun by our advance.
0423__L13_CPT_67__A8C45F2A.mp3.translation: 干得好，弟兄们。日军防线被我们切成两截了。他们要么后撤，要么等着被我们突破。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干得好，弟兄们。日军防线被我们切成两截了。他们要么后撤，要么等着被我们突破。

0424__L13_Pol_68__3D3F5F45.mp3.asr_text: Next stop, Tokyo! We're gonna ram it right down Tojo's throat, right, Captain?
0424__L13_Pol_68__3D3F5F45.mp3.translation: 下一站，东京！一路打到东条英机家门口，对吧，上尉？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 下一站，东京！一路打到东条英机家门口，对吧，上尉？

0425__L13_CPT_69__A8E08E2C.mp3.asr_text: Well, the road's open, Polanski, but we're not at the end of the line just yet.
0425__L13_CPT_69__A8E08E2C.mp3.translation: 路是打通了，波隆斯基，但还没走到头呢。
0425__L13_CPT_69__A8E08E2C.mp3.note: Polanski疑似Polonsky，统一人名波隆斯基。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 路是打通了，波隆斯基，但还没走到头呢。

0426__L13_Red_39__170C1225.mp3.translation: 中士，咱们的谢尔曼来了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，咱们的谢尔曼来了！

0427__L13_CPT_15__A01FF50D.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant, I want that bunker out of action!
0427__L13_CPT_15__A01FF50D.mp3.translation: 中士，我要那座碉堡彻底哑火！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，我要那座碉堡彻底哑火！

0428__L13_Red_12__133FBC60.mp3.asr_text: They're dug in at each end of the trench, Sarge.
0428__L13_Red_12__133FBC60.mp3.translation: 中士，战壕两头都有他们的工事。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，战壕两头都有他们的工事。

0429__L13_Red_34__16C59CA0.mp3.asr_text: MG, it's covering the whole approach.
0429__L13_Red_34__16C59CA0.mp3.translation: 机枪把整条路都封住了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 机枪把整条路都封住了。

0431__L13_Sul_44__90143D66.mp3.asr_text: Nail that guy! Keep him off the tank!
0431__L13_Sul_44__90143D66.mp3.translation: 干掉那家伙！别让他靠近坦克！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干掉那家伙！别让他靠近坦克！

0434__L13_Sul_9__4F3D2FCF.mp3.asr_text: Let's go, men! Move! Move! Move!

0435__L13_Sul_1__4ECC73C7.mp3.asr_text: Yeah, Polonsky. This stands between us and the last Japanese position on the island.
0435__L13_Sul_1__4ECC73C7.mp3.translation: 对，波隆斯基。过了这儿，就是日军在岛上最后的阵地。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 对，波隆斯基。过了这儿，就是日军在岛上最后的阵地。

0436__L13_Pol_2__22C6310B.mp3.asr_text: Real nice spot. Bunkers and mortars look dug in.
0436__L13_Pol_2__22C6310B.mp3.translation: 好地方啊，碉堡和迫击炮都藏好了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 好地方啊，碉堡和迫击炮都藏好了。

0437__L13_Sul_40__8FDBDF62.mp3.asr_text: Well, look who decided to show. About time.
0437__L13_Sul_40__8FDBDF62.mp3.translation: 瞧瞧谁总算来了，可算等到了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 瞧瞧谁总算来了，可算等到了。

0438__L13_Pol_63__3CF8E9C0.mp3.asr_text: Funker secure! The place is ours!
0438__L13_Pol_63__3CF8E9C0.mp3.translation: 碉堡拿下了！这里归我们了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 碉堡拿下了！这里归我们了！

0439__L13_Sul_16__8B11E28B.mp3.asr_text: Alright, move up and keep your heads down!

0440__L13_Sul_13__8AE79C08.mp3.asr_text: Spread out and clear those caves!

0441__L13_Sul_26__8CC6BB2A.mp3.asr_text: Work your way left and get into the bunker tunnel!

0444__L13_Pol_50__3B19CA9E.mp3.asr_text: Miller, if you got any bright ideas, pal, now's the time!
0444__L13_Pol_50__3B19CA9E.mp3.translation: 米勒，伙计，有什么好主意就赶紧提出来！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒，伙计，有什么好主意就赶紧提出来！

0446__L13_Sul_46__90306C68.mp3.asr_text: Use the Sherman for cover, damn it! That's what armor support's for!
0446__L13_Sul_46__90306C68.mp3.translation: 妈的，躲在谢尔曼后面！坦克就是来掩护咱们的！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 妈的，躲在谢尔曼后面！坦克就是来掩护咱们的！

0447__L13_Sul_38__8E97C2CB.mp3.asr_text: Keep to the riverbed and watch out for the enemy.
